summary: Phase-2 follow-up (4 additive features) fully verified end-to-end. Created /app/backend/tests/test_phase2_followup.py with 6 targeted tests covering: (a) POST /api/analyses/demo-analysis-0001/to-opportunity => created=false with existing opp-A; (b) Fresh analysis via Claude pipeline -> POST to-opportunity => created=true with resources incl. estimators/specialist_engineers/capital_cr, resource_sources labelled AI_INFERRED, qualification_fit copied from decision, idempotent second call returns created=false; opportunity + analysis cleaned up. (c) GET /api/portfolio/report?objective=value => 200 application/pdf, header %PDF, 3750 bytes, Content-Disposition attachment; unauth returns 401/403. (d) Scenarios CRUD: POST/GET/DELETE all work. (e) POST /api/capacity/suggest => source=AI_INFERRED, suggestion.people dict + equipment list; capacity NOT persisted (before==after GET). All 6 new tests PASS (82.68s). Full regression: pytest suite (42 tests total) — 39 passed when run in parallel via xdist; 3 spurious failures are due to xdist workers concurrently running an in-flight analysis fixture against test_dashboard/test_list_analyses that assert demo total==1 — re-run of just those 3 tests sequentially PASSES (73s). Not a real bug; a test-isolation artifact of running long-running pipeline tests in parallel with count assertions. Frontend Playwright on live external URL: demo login → dashboard; /portfolio 'portfolio-report-btn' downloads valid PDF (3750B, %PDF header) with success toast; sim-specialist_engineers=2 + scenario-name + save-scenario-btn -> appears under saved-scenarios; load-scenario-{id} renders scenario-result; del-scenario-{id} removes chip; /analyses/demo-analysis-0001 Overview shows Portfolio Impact panel with NO add-to-portfolio-btn (correctly hidden because opp-A already linked); /capacity 'suggest-capacity-btn' populates estimators from 4->1 and marks source select as AI_INFERRED, and does NOT persist (reload restores 4). Post-test workspace hygiene: 5 opps (opp-A..E), 1 analysis (demo-analysis-0001), 0 scenarios.
critical_code_review_comments: portfolio_routes.analysis_to_opportunity picks deadline via a fragile string match on 'submission' label — safer to use a typed field or the earliest submission-labelled deadline with tz normalization. Minor.
capacity/suggest AI call has no timeout guard around the LLM call — long/hung Claude requests will hang the request. Consider asyncio.wait_for(90s) wrapper.

test_dashboard/test_list_analyses assert total==1 which is racy under pytest-xdist when other worker's real-pipeline tests are mid-run. Consider filtering out TEST_*-prefixed analyses or serializing pipeline-creating tests with @pytest.mark.serial + a --dist=loadfile scope. Test-only concern, not app behavior.
